rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: palms only - spaced palms on the promenade and the median (zone 105 -> about 95)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's nine builder trees go (three broadleaf: a coral, a jacaranda, a magnolia; six palms); three palms come back on their own spots, spaced 80 m and more apart.

trees.why: the grass in front of the lookout rental and the flats, by their mailbox post (2.8 m off): a tall fan palm, the street's first along the slope
the same side 80 m down, opposite the steps-end flats: the palms spaced along the street that runs down to the promenade
the grass by the pier street arcade at the bottom of the block, where the walk reaches the shops and the promenade: a queen palm marks the corner
